name: shred-to-ribbons-class-bonus-attack-ally-5-life-power
notes: Shred to Ribbons's [Class Bonus] (GameLogic.php ~11658, inside the per-CardID POWER switch) adds +3 POWER to the ATTACK card's intent-loaded power when [Class Bonus] (GUARDIAN or WARRIOR) is active and DecisionQueueController::GetVariable('CombatTarget') resolves to an ALLY with 5+ current LIFE (ObjectCurrentHP). Playing this WIND-element ATTACK card for real from hand goes through an unrelated reserve/rearrange side-quest (a reveal-based alternate payment plus a deck-rearrange decision) that isn't part of its own ability, so instead Shred to Ribbons is seeded directly into myIntent via the zone setup primitive -- BridgeAddToZone only auto-populates Controller/Owner for zones matching */Field, so those are set explicitly via setProperties so IsClassBonusActive($obj->Controller, ...) resolves the correct player. P2 is patched to a WARRIOR champion (Lorraine, Wandering Warrior); a Dungeon Guide ALLY is seeded onto P1's field with Counters overridden to potion_animate_life=5 (Dungeon Guide's printed LIFE is only 3) as the attack target. P1 passes turn 1 (Rule 1.h), then P2's champion (0 printed power, no weapon) declares a real attack -- legal only because the seeded Intent card supplies positive power -- targeting the seeded ally; P1 declines the Retaliate? MZMAYCHOOSE. Total attack power is Shred to Ribbons's printed 2 + 3 from the Class Bonus = 5, exactly lethal to the LIFE-5 target (which dies and moves to the graveyard), vs. only 2 damage and survival without the bonus.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] As long as the attacker is attacking an ally with 5 [LIFE] or more, CARDNAME gets +3 [POWER]. (Apply this effect only if your champion's class matches this card's class.)
